changes.title: Invitations brooms
items: Before the party, take tonight's invitations from the desk in the Parlour (E): without them your 💌s and your Sentry hat throw nothing
Take a broom from the lathe in the Workshop (E): without one, step off the Terrace and you fall, thud, and come back at the magic circle
The invitations desk is bigger, messier and covered in 💌s; three plain brooms wait at the lathe, one for each witch
A pin points you to the invitations desk, then to the lathe, before the party
The Terrace's magic circle is bigger and carries the World Tree's sigil

changes.title: Zoo fence
items: The zoo's islands have tall gilded Versailles railings: fleur-de-lis, curly scroll bands, urns on the posts, and gilt lamps every 30 m lighting the street
The railings clear where they'd hide you, and you fly over them; the animals stay inside
The zoo's middle is the Ent's circle, lit, its World Tree glinting; the islands have no runestones, only their animals
At the zoo's edge the water foams over the lip and pours down into space

changes.title: Zoo like the map
items: The zoo is laid out like the sea chart: each animal's island where the chart has it, its own shape, the sea between them flagstone streets
Islands you haven't found yet are their biome's lake, the animal's sigil faint on the water (?zoo&all shows every island)
Every island has a little gold fence round it: animals stay on their island, and you fly over it
Each island's legend sleeps in its circle at the middle; home is just the Ent's sigil circle on a stone plaza (no treehouse or dancefloor), and at the zoo's edge the water pours off into space
The zoo is flat, and its islands sit closer together
